leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Vue component with a form using the Composition API
Configure a form schema with Zod to define validation rules
Integrate Vue Form with Zod using the vee-validate library
Bind form inputs to reactive state with validation rules
Manipulate form submission to handle validation results
Render validation error messages conditionally based on form state
Control form reset functionality to clear validation states
lessonTitle: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
